comment: The bank is stepped by two buttons rather than swept by a knob, as on the hardware, where only the samples sit under a knob; both displays can be right-clicked for the whole list. The sample knob spans its bank end to end, so its top is the last sample rather than the first again; the wrapping belongs to modulation. On the hardware, play and cue are the sign of one attenuverter, which means play mode can never be modulated downward; splitting the mode onto its own switch lets the attenuverter run the full range in either mode. The length knob does the envelope and the direction together, and at either end the envelope is held open, so on the longer generated banks a sequence becomes a drone rather than a run of hits. The kits folder is shared with pellicula. The module is built after Bastl Instruments' Citadel, and its bottom half is the same circuit as artifex's. The panel prints vates, bank, sample, play/cue, trig, pitch, mod, free, note, length, filter, fx, tempo, clk, sync, rate, mod, reset, pwm, env, tri, saw, pulse, rhythm, gate ptrn, cv ptrn, reset, gate, cv, clk, level, L and R.
